title: Lint rules on the static type of a reference
summary: Project lint rules on index fact ref_types: is-always-true, upcast-then-downcast, with-on-temporary, interface-holder-of-non-refcounted, argument-narrows, and sharper redundant-cast and unsafe-typecast-without-is
intro: Read this to see which rules stand on ref_types, what each reports and what keeps it silent. They run in lint-all and lint-project over a 1.44 index.
